## Email to Discord
Every new email in this inbox (that passes your filters) is posted to a Discord channel: sender, subject, 300-character preview.

1. Add an IMAP credential. Emails are not marked read or moved.
2. Edit **Filter** (sender / subject words / exclude).
3. Paste your Discord webhook URL in **Post to Discord**. Activate.

Several inboxes? Duplicate this workflow once per inbox, each with its own credential and webhook.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ username: "Email to Discord", allowed_mentions: { parse: [] }, embeds: [{ title: $json.subject.slice(0, 250), description: $json.preview || "(empty)", author: { name: $json.from.slice(0, 250) }, color: 5793266 }] }) }}
